# OpenVR dependency

This directory vendors Valve's official generated C# binding. The native Windows
x64 library is intentionally excluded from Git and fetched by `fetch-openvr.ps1`.

- Source: https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr
- Pinned commit: `0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05`
- C# source: `headers/openvr_api.cs`
- Native library: `bin/win64/openvr_api.dll`
- License: BSD 3-Clause, see `LICENSE`
